signature_features: drawings are black line art on a white page scan, Times serif atom labels, no colour or shading anywhere

scheme titles centred and underlined (Scheme I, Method 1); a “-continued” heading is centred and plain (crop 07); table captions (TABLE 1, TABLE 5) are centred and plain, not underlined (crops 03, 08)
general formulas labelled with a plain Roman numeral, I or (I), flush right in the text column at the level of the top of the drawing, not bold

variable groups as R with superscript numbers (R2, R3) or italic superscript letters (RN, RX); ring atoms E1, E2 and G1 to G4 as bare letters at ring vertices; unspecified rings A and B drawn as an open loop, a circle or a hexagon with the letter inside
each structure sits in justified two-column body text with line numbers 5, 10, 15 in the gutter

notes.compound_label_face: plain Roman I in crops 01 and 05; example numbers 1-1 plain in crop 03
notes.conditions_split: letters keyed to a footnote in crop 05; reagent class above and Step n below in crop 06 (all four steps) and crop 07 (step 6 wholly above; steps 5, 7 and 8 have reagent words on both sides of the arrow); no single rule
notes.yield_placement: no yields on any drawing seen; patents give yields in the example text
notes.abbreviate_groups: Me and iPr written as text only in crop 09; not enough agreement
notes.arrow_length: long reagent arrows: crop 06 4.1 to 4.7 bond lengths (mean 4.4; 242, 211 and 225 px on a 52 px bond); crop 07 2.1 to 4.3 (mean 3.3; 107 to 220 px on a 51 px bond); 4.0 is kept as the value between the two; crop 05 short lettered arrows are 1.2 to 2.0 bond lengths (mean 1.5; arrow c 81 px on a 54 px bond), a different arrow type that does not set this value
notes.bond_length_over_cap_height: ring bond over flat capital height, measured on the evidence crops: crop 01 3.8, 02 4.1, 03 3.5, 05 3.9, 06 2.7, 07 3.4; crop 04 and 09 not measured; median about 3.6; the earlier value 3.0 sat below the median and was closest to crop 06
notes.atom_label_size_pt_estimate: 7.5 pt was derived from the earlier 3.0 ratio and has not been re-derived, because the crops carry no point scale
notes.line_width_over_bond_length: strokes 2 to 3 px wide on ring bonds of 51 to 61 px (0.04 to 0.06); 0.047 kept as the middle of the range
notes.bold_width_over_bond_length: one wedge measured in crop 09 (13 px at the wide end on the card's 64 px bond, 0.2); the bold ring bonds in crop 09 are thinner, about 0.07 to 0.12 of the bond, so 0.2 describes wedges only

signature_features: formula label (I) or I flush right in the text column, at the level of the top of the drawing and beyond its right end, plain type
R groups as R with superscript numbers (R2, R3, R4) or italic superscript letters (RN, RX); ring atoms as E1, E2 or G1 to G4 with subscript numbers, bare letters at ring vertices

unspecified rings drawn as an open loop with the letter inside (ring A, crop 01), a circle with the letter inside (ring A, crop 02) or a hexagon with the letter inside (ring B, crop 01); substituent position left open by a bond crossing the ring
attachment points shown by a wavy line across the bond
variable definitions as running justified text beginning wherein ..., not a table
markush.notes: two patents agree on all of these; black only. Ring shape varies within the two crops (loop, circle, hexagon), so all three forms are listed

signature_features: table caption in capitals centred above the table, plain type (TABLE 1, crop 03); the first table page has thick black horizontal rules above and below the header Ex. # / Chemical Structure (crop 03)
a table fragment with no header shows a single thick rule at its top and no caption (crop 04)
one example compound per row, example number (1-1, 2, 3) plain at the row start (crop 03) or at the margin (crop 04)
single structure in body text with no table, caption or example number (crop 09)
no highlighting of varied substituents; stereo shown by bold wedges with small italic (S) and P descriptors (crop 09)
structure_panel.notes: labels are example numbers, so intermediate_label_style is left null. The table caption and header rules rest on crop 03 alone; crop 04 is a fragment from another patent and shows only the top rule; crop 09 has no table, so the table features do not apply to it

signature_features: underlined centred title for a scheme (Scheme I, Method 1); a centred, plain “-continued” heading on a continuation page (crop 07)

generic intermediates with R groups and ring placeholders, ring-atom letters bare at vertices (crops 06, 07); the final generic product of Scheme I is labelled with a plain Roman numeral I (crop 05); Method 1 products (crops 06, 07) carry no numeral
either lower-case letters beside the arrow keyed to a footnote line a) SOCl2, DMF (cat.), DCM; b) ... or reagent words above the arrow with Step n below (the words may straddle the arrow, crop 07)
no yields, no colour
reaction_scheme.notes: Roman-numeral labelling seen only for the final formula I in crop 05; intermediates in crops 06 and 07 are unlabelled. The arrow-length spread is recorded in conventions.notes.arrow_length

conventions.activity_format: binned symbols +, ++, +++ with the bin limits stated under the caption on two legend lines (IC50/EC50 Bins and PercentActivity Bins)

a rule under the legend block and a heavier rule under the column header row
centred columns Compd. No., Binned EC50, Binned Max Efficacy; no structures in the table
